def transform(g):
    cells=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=7]
    sep=max(set(v for r,c,v in cells),key=lambda v:sum(x==v for r,c,x in cells))
    obj=next(v for v in set(x for r,c,x in cells) if v!=sep)
    pts=[(r,c) for r,c,v in cells if v==obj]
    h=max(r for r,c in pts)+1;w=max(c for r,c in pts)+1
    out=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        row=[]
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r%h][c%w]!=obj: row.append(7)
            elif g[(r//h)%h][(c//w)%w]==obj: row.append(obj)
            else: row.append(sep)
        out.append(row)
    return out
